entities.summary: Alexander Mach, was a Slovak nationalist politician. Mach was associated with the far right wing of Slovak nationalism and became noted for his strong support of Nazism and Germany. Alexander Mach was a journalists & chroniclers from Palárikovo (1902-10-11, Palárikovo–1980-10-15). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
